integrity: Original proof and reproducible standard-library checks are provided. Claims of bibliographic originality are provisional relative to inspected literature, with stated residual risks.
limitations: Classification is solely for rank-exactly-one weight-zero operators on the exterior algebra on three generators. No higher-rank classification, independent validation, or priority certification is asserted. Finite-field checks supplement an all-fields proof.
title: Characteristic jumps in rank-one Rota–Baxter operators on a three-generator exterior algebra
